{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool coat, relaxed fit, knee-length, #2c2f33, heavy woven wool.
Mid-weight dark denim jeans, straight-leg cut, ankle length, #1a1a1a, durable cotton twill.
Cream knit button-up blouse, tailored silhouette, hip-length, #e8e6dc, soft merino wool blend.
Black leather ankle boots, block heel, calf-high shaft, #0d0d0d, smooth calfskin with salt-resistant treatment.

This outfit is perfect for a frosty, snowy autumn walk because the dark denim and thick wool coat provide essential warmth against the cold while remaining stylish enough for an everyday occasion. The cream blouse adds a necessary soft contrast to the heavy outer layers, creating a balanced look that doesn't feel too severe for a casual outing. Finally, the salt-resistant leather boots ensure comfort and protection on potentially icy or treated city streets without sacrificing elegance."}
